name: proto-bridge
description: Local prototype evidence capture, storage, handoff, and consumption for coding agents.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @proto-bridge/core build && pnpm --filter @proto-bridge/local-service build && pnpm --filter @proto-bridge/cli build && pnpm --filter @proto-bridge/mcp-server build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @proto-bridge/core build && pnpm --filter @proto-bridge/local-service typecheck && pnpm --filter @proto-bridge/cli typecheck && pnpm --filter @proto-bridge/mcp-server typecheck
scripts.test:e2e:mcp: pnpm --filter @proto-bridge/core build && pnpm --filter @proto-bridge/mcp-server build && node scripts/test-mcp-evidence.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:consumer: pnpm --filter @proto-bridge/core build && pnpm --filter @proto-bridge/mcp-server build && node scripts/test-consumer.mjs
